descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的纸菜单里，米饭从汤下回到小勺上。
descriptions.en: On my handmade menu, the rice resurfaces on the spoon.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我画的盘子接住了糖粉，衣襟旁只有两道多余的小掸痕。
descriptions.en: My paper menu lets the plate catch the sugar and gives my clean shirt two unnecessary brush marks.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我剪的两块轮廓短暂重叠，记着隧道里鱼与邮包碰巧遇上的角度。
descriptions.en: Two shapes I cut overlap briefly, recalling a fish passing above the mailbag.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己折的歪角纸片，记着隔着距离互相歪头的问候。
descriptions.en: My tilted paper corner recalls a greeting exchanged at a respectful distance.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我给小朋友另折的一条原创纸鱼，侧面小折角是它自己的包，不放入水里。
descriptions.en: Another original paper fish I folded, with its own little side bag; this fish stays out of water.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使用纸条折成的短环，两端都收好了，只记那次转圈的小事。
descriptions.en: My short paper loop keeps both ends tucked away, recalling our unhelpful turning.
